medicaid_aba_pathway: ABA covered fee-for-service under EPSDT for under-21s with autism dx; Alabama Medicaid Mental Health services area (Provider Billing Manual Ch. 37); no MCOs — ACHN network is primary-care coordination only

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered for members under 21 via EPSDT under AHCCCS (Arizona's Medicaid, an 1115-waiver managed-care system; AMPM Policy 320-S); delivered through AHCCCS Complete Care MCO plans, or via DES/DDD health plans for ALTCS members with DD

medicaid_aba_pathway: ABA covered under EPSDT via State Plan Amendment 23-0009 (approved 8/25/2023, effective 10/1/2023); access runs largely through Medicaid managed-care plans - AmeriHealth Caritas DC, MedStar Family Choice, CareFirst CHPDC, and HSCSN for children with special needs

typical_hours: No fixed weekly cap in policy; individualized by PA (verify)

typical_hours: No state-published standard; providers report ~10-25 hrs/wk focused and 26-40 hrs/wk comprehensive, set by BCBA plan and medical necessity (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $16.37/15-min unit (~$65.48/hr) under 101 CMR 358.00, eff. Oct 2024 (verify against current 358.00 schedule)
waiver_programs: DDS Children's Autism Waiver Program (birth through age 9); DDS Adult Autism Waiver
bcba_licensure: Yes — Licensed Applied Behavior Analyst (LABA); law enacted 2013 (M.G.L. c.112 §§163-172), licensing effective 2015; Board of Registration of Allied Mental Health and Human Services Professions

medicaid_aba_pathway: Michigan Medicaid Autism Benefit — Behavioral Health Treatment (ABA) under EPSDT for under-21 with ASD, delivered through regional PIHPs and county CMHSPs (families enter via their local CMHSP)
medicaid_agency: Michigan Dept of Health and Human Services (MDHHS), Behavioral Health and Developmental Disabilities Admin; michigan.gov/autism; Beneficiary Help Line 800-642-3195 (verify)
prior_auth: CMHSP arranges a comprehensive diagnostic evaluation (ADOS-2 plus clinical interview) by a qualified licensed practitioner; the CMHSP/PIHP then authorizes ABA hours under an individual plan of service/behavioral plan of care
autism_insurance_mandate: 2012 PA 99/100 (eff. 10/15/2012), coverage through age 18; statutory annual caps ($50K/$40K/$30K by age) removed for fully insured plans by DIFS in 2014 under ACA/parity rules
typical_hours: ~5-25 hrs/wk by medical necessity: focused ~5-15 hrs/wk, comprehensive ~16-25 hrs/wk (CMHSP/MDHHS best-practice guidance)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $16.50/15-min unit ($66.00/hr), state-directed minimum for PIHPs eff. Nov 1, 2024 (MDHHS L-25-78; CMS SPA MI-24-0022); older FFS screens ~$13.50/unit
waiver_programs: Children's Waiver Program (CWP, ages 0-17); Habilitation Supports Waiver (HSW); Waiver for Children with Serious Emotional Disturbance (SEDW) — all accessed via the local CMHSP
bcba_licensure: Yes — 2016 PA 403; Michigan Board of Behavior Analysts under LARA; licensure mandatory to practice since Jan 7, 2020

medicaid_aba_pathway: EIDBI (Early Intensive Developmental and Behavioral Intervention) benefit under Medical Assistance (Minn. Stat. 256B.0949) for under-21 with ASD or related conditions; ABA is one of several approved modalities (also ESDM, DIR/Floortime, PLAY Project)
medicaid_agency: Minnesota Dept of Human Services (DHS), Minnesota Health Care Programs (MHCP); mn.gov/dhs EIDBI page; 651-431-2700 / 800-366-5411
prior_auth: CMDE (Comprehensive Multi-Disciplinary Evaluation) establishes medical necessity; provider submits the Individual Treatment Plan (DHS-7109) plus CMDE for authorization to the DHS medical review agent (FFS) or the member's managed-care plan
autism_insurance_mandate: 2013 law (Minn. Stat. 62A.3094): state-regulated large-group plans (50+ employees) must cover autism treatment incl. ABA/EIBI for children under 18, no dollar caps; self-insured plans exempt
typical_hours: Individualized by ITP; intensive EIDBI commonly 20-40 hrs/wk, max 40 hrs/wk for young children, ~10 hrs/wk minimum to count as intensive (verify)
medicaid_rate: EIDBI individual intervention billed as 97153 (UB modifier) = $20.17/15-min unit (~$80.68/hr), MHCP fee schedule eff. 1/1/2024 at 100% for Level I providers (Level II 80%, Level III 50%) (verify current-year)
waiver_programs: DD Waiver; CADI Waiver; also BI and CAC waivers and MA-TEFRA (Katie Beckett) for children — apply via county/tribal agency
bcba_licensure: Yes — Licensed Behavior Analyst effective Jan 1, 2025 (Minn. Stat. 148.9981-148.9995), Minnesota Board of Psychology; before 2025 no state license (EIDBI used QSP provider qualifications)

medicaid_aba_pathway: EPSDT benefit for under-21 (Miss. Admin. Code Title 23, Part 223, Rule 6.3; ASD services added via SPA 16-0020); most children served through MississippiCAN CCOs — Magnolia Health, Molina Healthcare, TrueCare (TrueCare replaced UnitedHealthcare 7/1/2025)
medicaid_agency: Mississippi Division of Medicaid (DOM), Office of the Governor; medicaid.ms.gov; 800-421-2408; MESA portal
prior_auth: Requires an autism diagnosis by a physician or licensed psychologist plus prior authorization of a treatment plan developed/supervised by a MS-licensed behavior analyst (LBA/BCBA), submitted by the provider to the CCO or DOM's UM/QIO (vendor name verify)
autism_insurance_mandate: HB 885 (2015, eff. July 15, 2015; Miss. Code §83-9-26): ABA capped at 25 hrs/wk, not required beyond age 8, no dollar cap; some insurers voluntarily removed age caps; Medicaid EPSDT (to 21) NOT subject to these caps
typical_hours: No Medicaid-published range — hours set per authorized EPSDT treatment plan (verify); commercial mandate benchmark is up to 25 hrs/wk
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $15.08/15-min unit ($60.32/hr), DOM ASD fee schedule, rate eff. 12/1/2025 (PA required); 97151 $34.18, 97155/97156 $24.35 per unit
waiver_programs: ID/DD Waiver (1915(c), MS Dept of Mental Health Bureau of IDD; multi-year waitlist); 1915(i) IDD Community Support Program
bcba_licensure: Yes — 2015 (enacted with HB 885, eff. July 1, 2015); Mississippi Autism Board licenses Behavior Analysts (master's + active BCBA required) and Assistant Behavior Analysts

medicaid_aba_pathway: MO HealthNet state-plan ABA for under-21 (EPSDT/Healthy Children and Youth) with ASD diagnosis per 13 CSR 70-98.030; FFS or via managed care — Home State Health, Healthy Blue, UnitedHealthcare, plus Show Me Healthy Kids
medicaid_agency: MO HealthNet Division, Missouri Dept of Social Services; mydss.mo.gov/mhd; Participant Services 800-392-2161 (verify phone)
prior_auth: Provider submits precertification (form 2575-045) to MHD with a physician/psychologist ASD diagnosis plus the licensed behavior analyst's assessment and treatment plan; each precert covers up to 180 days; managed-care members use their plan's PA process
autism_insurance_mandate: HB 1311 (2010, eff. Jan 1, 2011): state-regulated plans cover ASD treatment incl. ABA to age 18; $40,000/yr ABA cap is inflation-adjusted annually ($57,311 for 2025)
typical_hours: Not published — regs require individualized hours based on age, school attendance, daily activities; ~10-25 hrs/wk focused / 26-40 comprehensive per national practice guidelines (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 eff. 7/1/2024 (tiered): $20.13/15-min unit ($80.52/hr) LBA/LaBA-supervised tier (HO/HN); $16.37/unit ($65.48/hr) RBT-delivered (HM) — MHD Bulletin Vol. 47 No. 09
waiver_programs: DMH Division of DD waivers: Comprehensive Waiver; Community Support Waiver; MO Children with DD Waiver (MOCDD, Sarah Jian Lopez Waiver); Partnership for Hope
bcba_licensure: Yes — 2010 (HB 1311; RSMo 337.300-337.345); Behavior Analyst Advisory Board under the State Committee of Psychologists, Division of Professional Registration

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered as a state-plan/EPSDT benefit for members age 20 and under with ASD (SED to 17); fee-for-service through Montana Healthcare Programs — no MCOs; governed by the Montana Medicaid Applied Behavior Analysis Services Manual
medicaid_agency: Montana DPHHS — Behavioral Health and Developmental Disabilities Division; Montana Healthcare Programs provider portal (medicaidprovider.mt.gov)
prior_auth: The directing BCBA submits prior authorization: an Intent to Initiate Treatment form plus a physician/licensed mental health professional prescription, diagnostic evaluation, behavior identification assessment, and a treatment plan with quantifiable goals; re-auth via Additional Units of Service Request after the initial 180 days
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2009 (SB 234, eff. 1/1/2010); covers ages 18 and under; statutory caps of $50,000/yr through age 8 and $20,000/yr ages 9-18 remain in MCA 33-22-515 but are generally unenforceable under federal parity (MHPAEA)
typical_hours: Initial authorization = 1,260 15-min units per 180 days (~315 hrs, ~12 hrs/wk average); more via re-authorization (verify)
waiver_programs: 0208 Comprehensive DD Waiver (Developmental Disabilities Program); Big Sky Waiver; former Children's Autism Waiver ended — ABA moved to the state-plan benefit (verify end year)
bcba_licensure: Yes — licensed since 2017 (SB 193) under the Montana Board of Psychologists

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered under EPSDT for children under 21 with ASD, delivered through the Heritage Health managed-care program — MCOs Nebraska Total Care, UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Nebraska, and Molina Healthcare of Nebraska administer the benefit (final ABA service definitions eff. 2/7/2025)
medicaid_agency: Nebraska DHHS — Division of Medicaid and Long-Term Care (Heritage Health program; dhhs.ne.gov)
prior_auth: Provider/BCBA obtains prior authorization from the member's Heritage Health MCO; requires an ASD diagnosis from a qualified provider, comprehensive diagnostic evaluation, and a BCBA-developed treatment plan (verify per-MCO forms)
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2014 (LB 254, eff. 1/1/2015); covers individuals under 21; caps ABA at 25 hrs/wk (no dollar cap) — hour/age limits generally unenforceable under federal parity (MHPAEA)
typical_hours: Up to 25 hrs/wk cited in the commercial mandate; Medicaid hours set by MCO medical-necessity review (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $18.70/15 min (~$74.80/hr) eff. 8/1/2025 (a ~48% cut from $36.11/unit per DHHS Health Plan Advisory 25-08)
waiver_programs: Comprehensive Developmental Disabilities Waiver; Family Support Waiver (children, ~$10,000/yr budget); DD Adult Day Waiver
bcba_licensure: Yes — Behavior Analyst Practice Act enacted 2023 (LB 227); licensure through Nebraska DHHS Division of Public Health (licenses issued from Sept 2024)

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered since 1/1/2016 under EPSDT for members under 21 with ASD (Medicaid Services Manual Ch. 3700; provider type 85), with coverage extended to adults in recent MSM updates (verify); available fee-for-service and through MCOs (Health Plan of Nevada, Anthem/Community Care, SilverSummit, Molina) in mandatory managed-care counties
medicaid_agency: Nevada DHHS — Division of Health Care Financing and Policy (DHCFP); Nevada Medicaid portal medicaid.nv.gov / nevadamedicaid.nv.gov
prior_auth: Prior authorization required before treatment: qualifying standardized diagnostic evaluation for ASD, functional assessment, and a treatment plan developed and overseen by a licensed psychologist or licensed behavior analyst (BCBA), submitted through Nevada Medicaid/the MCO
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2009 (AB 162, eff. 1/1/2011); covers under 18 (to 22 if enrolled in high school); statutory $36,000/yr ABA cap — dollar/age caps generally unenforceable under federal parity (MHPAEA)
typical_hours: not published (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $13.01/15 min (~$52/hr) RBT-delivered (UD modifier, eff. 1/1/2022); $30.10/15 min (~$120.40/hr) at licensed-analyst specialty level (eff. 3/10/2025) — official PT-85 fee schedule (data as of 07/2026)
waiver_programs: HCBS Waiver for Persons with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (ADSD); Katie Beckett Eligibility Option (TEFRA)
bcba_licensure: Yes — behavior analysts regulated since 2009 (AB 162, under Board of Psychological Examiners); independent Nevada Applied Behavior Analysis Board (NRS 641D) since 10/1/2021

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered for members under 21 as medically necessary under EPSDT (unbundled ABA codes since 5/1/2019); delivered through Medicaid Care Management MCOs — AmeriHealth Caritas NH, NH Healthy Families, and WellSense Health Plan
medicaid_agency: NH DHHS — Division of Medicaid Services (NH MMIS portal nhmmis.nh.gov; Provider Relations (866) 291-1674)
prior_auth: All ABA treatment requires service authorization from the member's MCO (InterQual criteria adopted 2026): ASD diagnostic evaluation plus a treatment plan covering direct treatment, supervision, and parent training components (verify per-MCO documentation)
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2010 (HB 569, "Connor's Law," eff. 1/1/2011); covers ages 0-21; caps of $36,000/yr through age 12 and $27,000/yr ages 13-21 — dollar/age caps generally unenforceable under federal parity (MHPAEA)
typical_hours: not published (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $15.00/15 min at 2019 unbundling; ~$17.79/15 min (~$71/hr) per 2026 rate trackers — not published in an easily accessible schedule (verify via NH MMIS)
waiver_programs: In Home Supports Waiver for Children with Developmental Disabilities (ages 0-21); Developmental Disabilities Waiver; Home Care for Children with Severe Disabilities (Katie Beckett-type)
bcba_licensure: No state licensure law — practice under national BACB certification (per BACB U.S. licensure list)

medicaid_aba_pathway: NJ FamilyCare ABA benefit launched 4/1/2020 under EPSDT for members under 21 with ASD; administered entirely through the five NJ FamilyCare MCOs — Aetna Better Health, Fidelis Care NJ (formerly WellCare), Horizon NJ Health, UnitedHealthcare Community Plan, and Wellpoint (formerly Amerigroup)
medicaid_agency: NJ Department of Human Services — Division of Medical Assistance and Health Services (DMAHS); NJ FamilyCare, 1-800-701-0710
prior_auth: The ABA provider obtains prior authorization from the member's MCO for assessment (97151) and treatment codes: requires an ASD diagnosis from a comprehensive diagnostic evaluation (physician/psychologist) and a BCBA-developed treatment plan
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2009 (P.L. 2009 c.115, eff. 2/9/2010) — first state to also cover other developmental disabilities; under 21; original $36,000/yr ABA cap (inflation-indexed) rendered unenforceable under federal parity per DOBI Bulletin 10-02
typical_hours: not published — set by MCO medical-necessity review (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $15.00/15 min (~$60/hr) FFS reference rate; MCO-contracted rates vary (verify)
waiver_programs: No autism-specific waiver — ABA is a state-plan MCO benefit; Children's System of Care (PerformCare) programs for youth with I/DD-ASD; DDD Supports Program and Community Care Program at 21+ (all under NJ's 1115 Comprehensive Demonstration)
bcba_licensure: Yes — licensed since 2019 (P.L. 2019); NJ State Board of Applied Behavior Analyst Examiners (Division of Consumer Affairs)

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered under EPSDT via Turquoise Care (Medicaid managed care since July 2024); three-stage ABA benefit (Stage 1 diagnostic eval, Stage 2 assessment/Integrated Service Plan, Stage 3 treatment) per NMAC 8.321.2.13; delivered through MCOs BCBS of NM, Molina, and Presbyterian; covers ages 12 months-21, including at-risk children 12-36 months before formal diagnosis
medicaid_agency: New Mexico Health Care Authority (HCA), Medical Assistance Division, (505) 827-3100; fee schedules at hca.nm.gov
prior_auth: Autism Evaluation Practitioner (licensed psychologist or qualified physician) completes Comprehensive Diagnostic Evaluation and Integrated Service Plan; BCBA develops treatment plan; direct treatment (97153) requires prior authorization renewed every 6 months (evals/assessments do not)
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2009 (SB 39, effective Jan 2010); originally capped at age 19 (22 if in high school), $36,000/yr and $200,000 lifetime; HB 322 (2019) removed age and dollar caps
typical_hours: Not state-published; hours individualized in the ISP/treatment plan (industry norm ~10-25 hrs/wk focused, 26-40 hrs/wk comprehensive) (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 tiered by renderer (per 15 min, FFS eff. 1/1/25): behavior technician $19.85 (~$79.40/hr), BCaBA $23.35, BCBA $32.31 (~$129.24/hr); MCOs may not pay below FFS rate
waiver_programs: Developmental Disabilities (DD) Waiver, Mi Via Self-Directed Waiver, Medically Fragile Waiver (Supports Waiver ended June 2026)
bcba_licensure: No state licensure law; BACB certification (BCBA/BCaBA) required by Medicaid to render ABA

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered under EPSDT for members under 21 with ASD (or Rett syndrome) diagnosis; carved into Medicaid Managed Care plans effective Jan 1, 2023 (FFS via eMedNY otherwise); delivered by NYS Licensed Behavior Analysts; not reimbursable in school settings
medicaid_agency: New York State Department of Health, Office of Health Insurance Programs (NY Medicaid); Medicaid Helpline (800) 541-2831; claims via eMedNY
prior_auth: Referral/order from a NYS-licensed Medicaid-enrolled physician, psychologist, psychiatric/pediatric NP, or PA; LBA completes assessment and treatment plan; authorization through the member's managed care plan (or FFS)
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted Nov 2011 (S.4005-A/A.6305-A, effective Nov 2012); no age cap; regulation caps ABA at 680 hours/yr (originally $45,000/yr equivalent); caps generally unenforceable under federal mental health parity (verify)
typical_hours: Commercial mandate caps ABA at 680 hrs/yr (~13 hrs/wk); Medicaid hours individualized to treatment plan (industry norm 10-40 hrs/wk)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $14.45/15 min (~$57.80/hr) effective Apr 1, 2026, after phased 25% reduction from $19.26 (was $16.85 from Oct 2025) (verify current tranche)
waiver_programs: OPWDD Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS) Waiver; NYS Children's Waiver (child's own income counted, unlocks Medicaid regardless of parent income)
bcba_licensure: Yes; Licensed Behavior Analyst (LBA) license created 2014, administered by NYS Education Department Office of the Professions (State Board for Applied Behavior Analysis)

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered as Research-Based Behavioral Health Treatment (RB-BHT) for ASD under Clinical Coverage Policy 8F, via EPSDT for beneficiaries under 21 (adults 21+ possible if medically necessary); accessed through NC Medicaid Managed Care Standard Plans, Behavioral Health I/DD Tailored Plans, or LME/MCOs
medicaid_agency: NC Department of Health and Human Services, Division of Health Benefits (NC Medicaid); Medicaid Contact Center (888) 245-0179 (verify); provider portal NCTracks
prior_auth: Provider must obtain prior approval before rendering RB-BHT: Licensed Qualified Autism Service Provider (LQASP, e.g. licensed BCBA/psychologist) submits comprehensive diagnostic assessment plus a measurable treatment plan to the health plan/LME-MCO; plan reviewed at least every 6 months
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted Oct 2015 (SB 676, effective July 2016); covers under age 19; adaptive behavior treatment capped at $40,000/yr (CPI-adjusted; cap still in place)
typical_hours: Not state-published; hours individualized to authorized treatment plan (industry norm ~10-25 focused, 26-40 comprehensive hrs/wk) (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $20.81/15 min (~$83.24/hr); Oct 2025 10% budget cut was restored to prior levels Jan 2026
waiver_programs: NC Innovations Waiver (I/DD, long waitlist); CAP/C (Community Alternatives Program for Children)
bcba_licensure: Yes; Behavior Analyst Licensure Act (SB 103) signed May 2021, creating the NC Behavior Analyst Licensure Board (NCBALB); licenses issued since July 2023

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered as the 'Autism ABA service' under EPSDT for children under 21 (fee-for-service; no MCOs); requires ASD diagnosis from PCP/qualified provider plus a current ND Health Tracks (EPSDT) screening recommending ABA; separate Medicaid Autism Spectrum Disorder waiver adds family supports
medicaid_agency: North Dakota Health and Human Services, Medical Services Division (ND Medicaid), (800) 755-2604; Autism Services unit within HHS
prior_auth: Family obtains annual approval letter from ND Medicaid (PCP diagnosis + Health Tracks screening recommending ABA); provider agency then submits web-based service authorization twice yearly (annual + 180-day update) with BCBA-written care plan justifying hours per week
autism_insurance_mandate: No statute; ND Insurance Department bulletin (July 2018, compliance by Jan 1, 2019) requires state-regulated plans to cover autism treatment incl. ABA at parity with medical/surgical benefits (48th state); no specific age/dollar caps in bulletin
typical_hours: Not state-published; hours requested per care plan with justification, majority delivered by RBT; 6-month progress reviews (verify)
medicaid_rate: Not clearly published; third-party compilation lists 97153 at $10.60/15 min (~$42.40/hr) (verify against ND HHS fee schedule portal)
waiver_programs: Medicaid Autism Spectrum Disorder Waiver (birth through age 17; expanded to birth through age 20 effective Nov 1, 2025); DD (Traditional IID/DD) Waiver
bcba_licensure: Yes; licensure enacted 2011 (SB 2155, NDCC ch. 43-32); Applied Behavior Analyst licensing now under the ND Board of Integrative Health Care (verify board history)

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered for under-21s via EPSDT (Healthchek) medical-necessity pathway — ABA never codified as a distinct Medicaid rule benefit (verify); accessed through Next Generation managed care plans (CareSource, Buckeye, etc.) or OhioRISE (Aetna specialty plan for children with complex behavioral health needs, adds care coordination and respite)
medicaid_agency: Ohio Department of Medicaid; Consumer Hotline (800) 324-8680; provider info at medicaid.ohio.gov
prior_auth: Prior authorization required for all ABA codes: provider submits DSM-5-TR-based comprehensive diagnostic evaluation by a qualified diagnosing practitioner plus individualized treatment plan and medical-necessity justification to the member's managed care plan or OhioRISE
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted Jan 2017 (HB 463, one of the last states); fully insured plans cover ages 0-14 with ABA limited to 20 hrs/wk (marketplace plans 0-21); age/hour caps generally unenforceable under federal mental health parity
typical_hours: Commercial mandate lists 20 hrs/wk ABA limit; Medicaid hours individualized to treatment plan (industry norm 10-40 hrs/wk) (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = ~$16.04/15 min (~$64.16/hr) FFS per third-party rate tracker (verify on ODM fee schedule); managed care plans negotiate own rates
waiver_programs: DODD waivers: Individual Options (IO), Level One, and SELF (self-directed) — all with county waitlists; OhioRISE 1915(c) waiver for children with complex needs
bcba_licensure: No traditional license; Certified Ohio Behavior Analyst (COBA) credential created 2013 (ORC ch. 4783), administered by the Ohio Board of Psychology; COBA required to bill Ohio Medicaid

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered for members under 21 as an EPSDT benefit under SoonerCare (OAC 317:30-3-65.12); BCBAs contract directly with OHCA as SoonerCare providers
medicaid_agency: Oklahoma Health Care Authority (OHCA); SoonerCare helpline 800-987-7767, provider line 800-522-0114
prior_auth: The contracted BCBA/provider submits a prior authorization to OHCA with a diagnostic evaluation and treatment plan; auths are granted in unit blocks for 1-6 months and reviewed by an OHCA reviewer, BCBA contractor and/or physician (OAC 317:30-5-314)
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2016 (HB 2962); originally capped ABA at 25 hrs/wk and $25,000/yr through roughly age 9; the Oklahoma Insurance Department declared those caps violations of federal parity law in 2021 and required their removal by end of 2021
typical_hours: Per medical necessity; authorized in 1-6 month unit blocks with no fixed weekly cap (verify exact range with OHCA)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $17.35 per 15 min (~$69.40/hr) on the SoonerCare fee schedule (unchanged through 7/1/2026)
waiver_programs: DDS (OKDHS) waivers: In-Home Supports Waiver for Children (ages 3-17), In-Home Supports Waiver for Adults, and the Community (HCBS) Waiver; long waiting list applies
bcba_licensure: Yes - one of the earliest states; behavior analyst licensure enacted 2009 (59 O.S. §1928), administered by the Oklahoma Licensed Behavior Analyst Board (OLBAB)

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered under the Oregon Health Plan (OHP) as an EPSDT/state-plan behavioral health benefit per HERC Prioritized List Guideline Note 75; most members access it through their Coordinated Care Organization (CCO), with fee-for-service (open card) auths handled by OHA's UM contractor
medicaid_agency: Oregon Health Authority (OHA), Health Systems Division; OHP Client Services 800-699-9075
prior_auth: Requires an ASD (or stereotypic movement disorder) diagnosis by an MD/DO/PhD/PsyD using standardized tools (e.g. ADOS); the ABA provider submits a treatment plan for prior authorization to the CCO or OHA's FFS UM contractor; initial assessment (97151) is retrospectively reviewed
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2013 (SB 365), effective for plans from Jan 1 2016; requires a minimum of 25 hrs/wk of ABA coverage; the 25-hour and age-9 standards are statutory floors not caps and no dollar cap applies
typical_hours: Per individualized medical necessity under HERC Guideline Note 75; SB 365's 25 hrs/wk is the commercial coverage floor (verify typical authorized range)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $14.70 per 15 min (~$58.80/hr) on the OHP Behavioral Health Fee Schedule (unchanged into 2026)
waiver_programs: ODDS I/DD services via the 1915(k) Community First Choice K Plan (no waitlist for attendant supports) plus 1915(c) children's waivers incl. Children's Intensive In-Home Services (CIIS), Children's HCBS Waiver and the Children's Extraordinary Needs Waiver (2024); ABA itself is a state-plan OHP benefit
bcba_licensure: Yes - SB 365 (2013) created licensure effective 2015; Behavior Analysis Regulatory Board under OHA's Health Licensing Office licenses LBAs, LABAs and registers behavior analysis interventionists

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered for under-21s through Medical Assistance (Medicaid) EPSDT as Intensive Behavioral Health Services - ABA (IBHS-ABA, replaced BHRS in 2020); delivered through the HealthChoices behavioral health carve-out via county BH-MCOs (e.g. Magellan, Community Care Behavioral Health, PerformCare)
medicaid_agency: Pennsylvania Department of Human Services (DHS), Office of Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services (OMHSAS); DHS Helpline 800-692-7462
prior_auth: The IBHS agency submits an authorization request to the county BH-MCO with a written order from a physician/psychologist, a behavioral assessment and an individual treatment plan; certain IBHS require prior authorization per the Jan 2020 MA fee schedule notice
autism_insurance_mandate: Act 62 enacted 2008 - first-in-nation autism mandate; $36,000/yr benefit maximum for individuals under 21; a Nov 2023 PA Insurance Department notice requires autism to be covered as a mental health condition under federal MHPAEA parity from Jan 1 2024, effectively superseding the dollar/age caps
typical_hours: Not standardized; hours set by the prescriber's order and BH-MCO medical-necessity review (verify)
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $12.73 per 15 min (~$50.92/hr) on the MA fee-for-service schedule; BH-MCO contracted rates vary
waiver_programs: ODP waivers serving autism/ID: Consolidated, Community Living and Person/Family Directed Support (P/FDS) waivers; autism-specific adult programs: Adult Autism Waiver (AAW) and Adult Community Autism Program (ACAP)
bcba_licensure: Partial - Act 62 (2008) created the Behavior Specialist license under the State Board of Medicine; PA licenses Behavior Specialists rather than a dedicated LBA credential and BCBA certification is not required for that license

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered under Medicaid EPSDT for members under 21; ABA is delivered by EOHHS-approved providers (incl. the Home Based Therapeutic Services/HBTS program) and accessed through RIte Care managed care plans - Neighborhood Health Plan of RI, UnitedHealthcare Community Plan and Tufts Health Public Plan
medicaid_agency: Rhode Island Executive Office of Health and Human Services (EOHHS); Medicaid customer service 401-462-5300
prior_auth: Prior authorization is required for HBTS/ABA services; the provider submits the request (via the MCO or Gainwell Technologies for FFS) with a diagnostic evaluation and individualized treatment plan
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2011 (H 5275 Sub A), effective Jan 1 2012; ABA capped at $32,000/yr for children under 15; those dollar/age caps are unenforceable under the federal MHPAEA parity law
typical_hours: Not standardized in published policy; based on medical necessity (verify)
medicaid_rate: Not published in the current EOHHS fee schedule for 97153 - a 2021 EOHHS document listed $17.50 per 30-min unit (~$35/hr) and actual rates are MCO-negotiated (verify)
waiver_programs: Rhode Island runs a single 1115 demonstration (Global Waiver) rather than separate autism waivers; children access Medicaid via Katie Beckett eligibility and services incl. HBTS, Kids Connect and PASS
bcba_licensure: Yes - licensure enacted 2012 (S 2559; R.I. Gen. Laws ch. 5-86); Applied Behavior Analyst Licensing Board within the RI Department of Health licenses applied behavior analysts and assistant analysts

medicaid_aba_pathway: Covered under Healthy Connections Medicaid as a state-plan Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) Services benefit via EPSDT (added 2017 after the DDSN PDD/EIBI waiver ended); members in managed care get ABA through their Healthy Connections MCO, which handles authorization and payment
medicaid_agency: South Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (SCDHHS); Healthy Connections member line 888-549-0820, provider line 888-289-0709
prior_auth: The ABA provider requests prior authorization from SCDHHS (FFS) or the member's MCO with a comprehensive diagnostic evaluation confirming ASD and a treatment plan; families are directed to contact an enrolled ASD provider to initiate the auth
autism_insurance_mandate: Ryan's Law enacted 2007 (effective July 2008) - one of the first state mandates; up to $50,000/yr for behavioral therapy through age 16 for children diagnosed by age 8; caps of this kind are generally unenforceable under federal MHPAEA parity for covered plans (verify current cap status)
typical_hours: Up to 40 hrs/wk - 97153 is capped at 160 15-min units per week under the SCDHHS ASD manual
medicaid_rate: 97153 = $14.88 per 15 min (~$59.52/hr) effective July 1 2023
waiver_programs: BHDD/DDSN-operated HCBS waivers: Community Supports (CS) Waiver, Intellectual Disability/Related Disabilities (ID/RD) Waiver and Head and Spinal Cord Injury (HASCI) Waiver; the autism-specific PDD waiver ended Dec 31 2017 when ABA moved to the state plan
bcba_licensure: No - South Carolina has no behavior analyst licensure law (licensure bills such as S.630 have not passed); providers practice on BACB (BCBA) certification, which SCDHHS requires for enrollment

medicaid_aba_pathway: ABA covered under the EPSDT benefit for children 20 and younger with an ASD diagnosis; straight fee-for-service South Dakota Medicaid (no MCOs); billed by enrolled behavior analysts, psychologists, or physicians
medicaid_agency: South Dakota Department of Social Services (DSS), Division of Medicaid Services — dss.sd.gov
prior_auth: Provider submits the ABA Services Prior Authorization Form with an ASD diagnosis made within 12 months by a physician or psychologist (GARS-3, ADOS-2, or ABAS evidence-based tool), a physician/NP/PA order, and a treatment plan with recommended weekly hours; authorizations run 6 months
autism_insurance_mandate: 2015 (SB 190); covers under age 19 with annual ABA caps by age (~$36,000 under 7; $25,000 ages 7-13; $12,500 ages 14-18); caps not removed (verify exact brackets)
typical_hours: Not published; weekly hours set individually in the prior-authorized treatment plan, re-authorized every 6 months
medicaid_rate: ~$21.73 per 15 min (~$86.92/hr) per 2026 rate tracker (verify against DSS ABA fee schedule)
waiver_programs: Family Support 360 waiver; CHOICES waiver (Division of Developmental Disabilities)
bcba_licensure: Yes — HB 1141 (2016); licensed under the SD Board of Social Work Examiners with an Applied Behavior Analyst Advisory Committee

medicaid_aba_pathway: ABA covered for members under 21 through TennCare's EPSDT benefit; access runs through the member's TennCare managed-care organization (BlueCare, UnitedHealthcare Community Plan, or Wellpoint/Amerigroup)
medicaid_agency: Division of TennCare (tn.gov/tenncare); TennCare Connect 855-259-0701
prior_auth: Prior authorization through the member's MCO; requires a comprehensive clinical evaluation with DSM-5 ASD diagnosis, a physician order/script for ABA, and a treatment plan with proposed hours from the supervising Licensed Behavior Analyst (BCBA/LBA)
autism_insurance_mandate: 2006 (TCA 56-7-2367) required parity with neurological-disorder coverage for children under 12 but not ABA; an Aug 1, 2019 Dept. of Commerce & Insurance bulletin required coverage of medically necessary ABA (compliance by 3/1/2020), making TN the 50th state; no annual dollar caps
typical_hours: No fixed cap; hours set by MCO medical-necessity review — comprehensive ABA defined as >25 hrs/wk vs focused treatment in MCO level-of-care guidelines
medicaid_rate: Not published (verify) — no statewide fee schedule; rates negotiated with each MCO
waiver_programs: Katie Beckett Program (Parts A/B); Employment and Community First (ECF) CHOICES for I/DD — both under the TennCare III 1115 demonstration
bcba_licensure: Yes — Applied Behavior Analyst Licensing Committee created 2014 under the TN Department of Health; licenses LBAs and LABAs

medicaid_aba_pathway: Autism Services benefit (ABA evaluation and treatment) added Feb 1, 2022 under the Texas Health Steps Comprehensive Care Program (THSteps-CCP/EPSDT) for ages 20 and younger; delivered fee-for-service via TMHP and through STAR/STAR Kids MCOs
medicaid_agency: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC); claims and prior auth through TMHP — tmhp.com, 800-925-9126
prior_auth: Licensed Behavior Analyst (LBA/BCBA) submits the CCP Prior Authorization Request with an ASD diagnosis, completed ABA evaluation, and treatment plan; requires referring/ordering provider; periodic reauthorization with updated plan
autism_insurance_mandate: 2007 (HB 1919, group plans ages 2-6); expanded 2009 and 2013 — SB 1484 removed the age cap but allowed an annual ABA max (~$36,000, verify) for enrollees age 10+
typical_hours: Direct treatment capped at 8 hrs/day (32 units combined across 97153/97154/97155/97158); comprehensive vs focused treatment per policy
medicaid_rate: $14.50 per 15 min ($58.00/hr) — TMHP Autism Services fee schedule, effective 9/1/2025
waiver_programs: HCS, Texas Home Living (TxHmL), CLASS, MDCP, and YES waivers — all with multi-year interest lists
bcba_licensure: Yes — SB 589 (2017), Behavior Analyst Licensing Act; Licensed Behavior Analyst through the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR), licensing began 2018

medicaid_aba_pathway: Autism Spectrum Disorder related services (including ABA) covered under EPSDT for members under 21 in Traditional Medicaid; ABA is a fee-for-service carve-out billed directly to Medicaid, not through ACOs or prepaid mental health plans
medicaid_agency: Utah Department of Health & Human Services, Division of Integrated Healthcare (Utah Medicaid) — medicaid.utah.gov; Health Program Representative 1-866-608-9422
prior_auth: The ABA provider works with the family to submit a prior-authorization request to the Medicaid agency with documentation of the ASD diagnosis, a copy of the completed diagnostic evaluation tool, and a written prescription for ABA from a qualified clinician
autism_insurance_mandate: 2014 (SB 57, effective 1/1/2016) — ages 2-10 with a 600-hour/year cap; SB 95 (2019, effective 1/1/2020) removed the age and hour caps
typical_hours: Not published; hours set per the prior-authorized treatment plan (the old commercial 600 hrs/yr cap, ~11.5 hrs/wk, was repealed)
medicaid_rate: ~$19.67 per 15 min (~$78.68/hr) per 2026 rate tracker (verify via Utah Medicaid fee schedule lookup)
waiver_programs: Community Supports Waiver (DSPD) — the main HCBS option; the legacy Utah Medicaid Autism Waiver is closed to new applicants
bcba_licensure: Yes — SB 246 (2015), Behavior Analyst Licensing Act; Utah Division of Occupational and Professional Licensing (DOPL)

medicaid_aba_pathway: Vermont Medicaid ABA Benefit under EPSDT for children birth to age 21, supervised by board-certified behavior analysts; administered statewide by DVHA under the Global Commitment to Health 1115 demonstration (no MCOs)
medicaid_agency: Department of Vermont Health Access (DVHA) — dvha.vermont.gov; ABA benefit questions: AHS.DVHAABABenefit@vermont.gov
prior_auth: All ABA services other than the initial assessment must be prior authorized by DVHA; the supervising BCBA submits documentation of the ASD diagnosis and a treatment plan meeting DVHA's ABA Clinical Guidelines
autism_insurance_mandate: 2010 (S.262, effective 7/1/2011); Act 158 (2012) extended required coverage of ABA for autism/early childhood developmental disorders from birth to age 21 across private plans and Medicaid; no age or dollar caps under current law (verify)
typical_hours: Authorized intensity spans DVHA's monthly case-rate tiers, from ~2-6 hrs/month up to 170+ hrs/month (roughly up to ~40 hrs/wk), effective 1/1/2026
medicaid_rate: Historically ~$15.00 per 15 min (~$60/hr); replaced by tiered monthly case rates ($219-$13,667/month by hours tier) effective 1/1/2026
waiver_programs: Global Commitment to Health 1115 waiver funds HCBS; Developmental Disabilities Services (DDSD/DAIL) home- and community-based supports for children with I/DD including autism
bcba_licensure: Yes — Act 38 (2015, effective 7/1/2016); licensed by the Vermont Secretary of State's Office of Professional Regulation (26 V.S.A. ch. 95)

medicaid_aba_pathway: ABA covered for members under 21 through the EPSDT benefit as DMAS Behavioral Therapy services under Cardinal Care; delivered via Medicaid managed-care plans (Aetna, Anthem HealthKeepers Plus, Sentara, UnitedHealthcare) or fee-for-service
medicaid_agency: Department of Medical Assistance Services (DMAS); Cardinal Care / vamedicaid.dmas.virginia.gov provider portal
prior_auth: Prior authorization required before services start: the ABA provider submits a documented autism diagnosis and a treatment plan showing medical necessity to the member's managed-care plan or DMAS's service authorization contractor; services must be rendered by or under supervision of a Licensed Behavior Analyst
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2011 (HB 2467, effective 1/1/2012) initially for ages 2-6; age cap raised to 10 in 2015 and eliminated in 2019 (HB 2577); ABA subject to a $35,000 maximum annual benefit; extended to individual/small-group plans in 2020
typical_hours: Up to 20 hrs/wk cumulative ABA limit effective 7/1/2026, exceedable with documented medical necessity under EPSDT
medicaid_rate: 97153: $15.00/15 min technician-delivered (= $60.00/hr); up to $46.63/15 min when delivered by a Licensed Behavior Analyst (HO modifier); unchanged since 2021
waiver_programs: Three DD waivers administered with DBHDS: Community Living (CL), Family and Individual Supports (FIS), Building Independence (BI); apply via local Community Services Board
bcba_licensure: Yes - licensed since 2012 by the Virginia Board of Medicine (LBA / LABA)

medicaid_aba_pathway: Apple Health (Medicaid) ABA benefit: eligibility requires a comprehensive evaluation and ABA order from a recognized Center of Excellence (COE) provider; services delivered through Apple Health managed-care organizations or fee-for-service
medicaid_agency: Washington State Health Care Authority (HCA); hca.wa.gov Apple Health
prior_auth: ABA provider must obtain prior authorization from HCA or the member's MCO before treatment, submitting the COE comprehensive evaluation/order plus the assessment and treatment plan; authorizations granted in 3-6-month increments with recertification by the lead behavior analysis therapist
autism_insurance_mandate: 2014 - coverage required under Washington's Mental Health Parity Act following the WA Supreme Court O.S.T. v. Regence ruling and an Insurance Commissioner order (SB 5059 also cited (verify)); no age, dollar, or visit caps
typical_hours: Individualized per COE order and treatment plan; no fixed cap (ABA day program for under-6s typically 12-15 hrs/wk group)
medicaid_rate: 97153: $12.40/15 min (= $49.60/hr) per HCA ABA fee schedule eff. 7/1/2026 (verify)
waiver_programs: DDA HCBS waivers: Basic Plus, Core, Individual and Family Services (IFS), Children's Intensive In-Home Behavioral Supports (CIIBS), Community Protection
bcba_licensure: Yes - law enacted 2015 (SB 5488), credentials effective 2017; WA Department of Health (LBA, LABA, Certified Behavior Technician)

medicaid_aba_pathway: ABA covered for children under 21 via EPSDT under Medicaid Chapter 519.23 (Applied Behavior Analysis, practitioner services); ASD diagnosis must be made before the child's eighth birthday (verify current rule)
medicaid_agency: WV Bureau for Medical Services (BMS), Department of Human Services; bms.wv.gov
prior_auth: Prior authorization through Acentra Health (formerly Kepro), the state's ASO, is required before any ABA service is rendered; the BCBA provider submits the diagnostic documentation and treatment plan (Acentra: 304-343-9663)
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2011 (HB 2693, effective 1/1/2012; corrected by HB 4260 in 2012); covers ages 18 months-18 years diagnosed by age 8; ABA capped at $30,000/year for 3 years then $2,000/month - caps not removed
typical_hours: Combined cap of 40 hrs/wk and 8 hrs per 24-hour period across ABA codes 97151-97158
waiver_programs: IDD Waiver (IDDW) and Children with Serious Emotional Disorder Waiver (CSEDW, ages 3-21, apply via 844-HELP4WV)
bcba_licensure: No state license - a 2012 Sunrise Report found BACB certification adequate; Medicaid requires BCBA certification

medicaid_aba_pathway: ForwardHealth Behavioral Treatment Benefit (since 1/1/2016) covering ABA and Early Start Denver Model as comprehensive or focused treatment for Medicaid members with autism or related behavioral conditions
medicaid_agency: Wisconsin Department of Health Services (DHS), Division of Medicaid Services; ForwardHealth portal (forwardhealth.wi.gov)
prior_auth: ForwardHealth requires a medical examination and written referral/prescription from a Medicaid-enrolled qualified medical provider plus a provider-submitted PA request with diagnostic documentation (validated tools such as ADOS-2/ADI-R) and treatment plan; initial PAs approved for up to 6 months
autism_insurance_mandate: Enacted 2009 (effective 11/1/2009): minimum $50,000/yr for intensive-level services (ages 2-9, minimum 4 years) and $25,000/yr for nonintensive-level services with no age limit; amounts CPI-adjusted annually since 2011 - caps still in place
typical_hours: Comprehensive treatment for young children vs focused treatment for specific behaviors; intensive-level defined in the mandate as 30-35+ hrs/wk (Medicaid hours individualized (verify))
medicaid_rate: 97153: $11.91/15 min technician-delivered (= $47.64/hr); higher with licensed-supervisor modifiers (up to $41.44/15 min TF); eff. 2/1/2023 (verify)
waiver_programs: Children's Long-Term Support (CLTS) Waiver (under 22, includes intensive autism services) plus Katie Beckett Medicaid eligibility pathway; Family Care/IRIS for adults
bcba_licensure: Yes - licensed since 2010 (2009 Wis. Act 282); WI Department of Safety and Professional Services

medicaid_aba_pathway: ABA covered as a preventive/EPSDT service (state plan amendment WY 24-0005, effective 7/1/2024) for Medicaid-enrolled children ages 0-20 with a primary autism spectrum disorder diagnosis
medicaid_agency: Wyoming Department of Health, Division of Healthcare Financing (Wyoming Medicaid); wyomingmedicaid.com, member line 855-294-2127
prior_auth: Enrolled behavior analyst submits a clinical assessment and treatment plan (recommended level of care, goals, objective measures) before services; plan must be updated every 90 days; EPSDT children exempt from the 20-visit rehabilitative limit (verify PA vendor details)
autism_insurance_mandate: No mandate statute; a 2019 Insurance Department bulletin (effective 7/1/2019) bars plans with mental-health coverage from excluding evidence-based ASD treatment - no legislated age or dollar caps
typical_hours: Not published as hrs/wk; fee schedule caps 97153 at 32 units (8 hrs) per day
medicaid_rate: 97153: $12.30/15 min (= $49.20/hr) per 7/1/2026 fee schedule; $19.23/15 min under DD waivers (verify)
waiver_programs: Comprehensive Waiver and Supports Waiver (HCBS for IDD/acquired brain injury, all ages, include behavioral support services)
bcba_licensure: Yes - law enacted 2022; Wyoming Board of Psychology
